Show what an LGX page became: the ordinary LOGOS its constructs lower to.

A `## Component` is not run as written: it becomes a render function that writes the view to a tape (`vdOpen`/`vdText`/`vdClose`) its commit turns into DOM calls, an action function per action, a mount entry and a dispatcher; a `## Route` becomes a function plus the synthesized `route(method, path)` walk. When a page behaves in a way its markup does not explain, the lowering is the answer — this prints it.

Usage: largo expand [OPTIONS] <FILE>

Arguments:
  <FILE>
          The source file to expand

Options:
  -q, --quiet
          Suppress informational output (errors still print)

  -v, --verbose...
          Increase output verbosity (repeatable)

      --color <WHEN>
          When to use terminal colors

          Possible values:
          - auto:   Color when stdout/stderr is a terminal and `NO_COLOR` is unset
          - always: Always emit ANSI, even into pipes (CI logs, `less -R`)
          - never:  Never emit ANSI
          
          [default: auto]

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

Examples:
  largo expand pages/app.lg
